name: What materials are commonly used in modern landscape design?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used in modern landscape design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern landscape design frequently utilizes materials that offer durability, a sleek appearance, and low maintenance. Common choices include poured-in-place concrete or large format pavers for patios and walkways, weathering steel (Corten) for planters or edging, and natural stone with clean cuts. Other popular materials are composite decking, aluminum for pergolas, and glass or stucco for vertical elements. The selection often prioritizes texture and visual interest over ornate details, contributing to the minimalist aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include concrete, large format pavers, weathering steel, natural stone, composite decking, and aluminum, chosen for durability and a sleek look.
